"""Synthetic picking moves paid reserved orders to packing."""
def complete(repo, order_id):
    with repo.transaction():
        order = repo.get("orders", order_id)
        if order is None or order["status"] != "reserved" or order["payment_state"] != "captured":
            raise ValueError("picking not allowed")
        repo.insert("picks", {"order_id": order_id, "status": "done"})
        order["status"] = "packing"
    return "packing"

"""Synthetic dispatch consumes reservation; no external carrier API."""
from modules.inventory.service import consume
from modules.outbox.service import enqueue

def dispatch(repo, order_id):
    with repo.transaction():
        order = repo.get("orders", order_id)
        packages = repo.find("packages", lambda row: row["order_id"] == order_id and row["status"] == "packed")
        if order is None or order["status"] != "packing" or not packages:
            raise ValueError("dispatch not allowed")
        for line in order["lines"]:
            consume(repo, line["product_id"], line["quantity"])
        order["status"] = "shipped"
        shipment = repo.insert("shipments", {"order_id": order_id, "zone": order["zone"], "status": "in_transit"})
        enqueue(repo, "order_shipped", order_id)
    return shipment

"""Synthetic confirmation checks the stored delivery zone."""
from modules.loyalty.service import grant
from modules.settlements.service import accrue

def confirm(repo, shipment_id, zone):
    with repo.transaction():
        shipment = repo.get("shipments", shipment_id)
        if shipment is None or shipment["status"] != "in_transit" or shipment["zone"] != zone:
            raise ValueError("delivery confirmation rejected")
        order = repo.get("orders", shipment["order_id"])
        if order["status"] != "shipped":
            raise ValueError("order not shipped")
        shipment["status"] = "delivered"
        order["status"] = "delivered"
        grant(repo, order["id"])
        accrue(repo, order["id"])
    return "delivered"
